response.sql: WITH pair AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS mkt, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY o.mktnote), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net) AS b FROM pair) SELECT AVG(p.avg_net) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - bench.b) AS avg_excess FROM pair p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_net > bench.b
